issues.description: Basic usage example contains unreachable/misleading code after a return statement
issues.detail: In the Image preview section, the second example (data URI) is shown as a commented-out return placed after the first return statement. While commented, the structure suggests two returns coexist in one function. Splitting into two separate example functions would be clearer and avoid confusion for readers copy-pasting.

issues.description: Pipeline node iteration example uses needlessly convoluted pattern
issues.detail: `training_node = next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is equivalent to `pipeline.nodes[0]` and confusing for new users. Docs should model idiomatic usage. Consider `training_node = pipeline.nodes[0]` or filter by name with `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes if n.name == 'train_model_node')` to teach a useful pattern.

issues.description: Closure example references undefined `process_data` function and stale node signature
issues.detail: The closure example calls `node(func=process_data, ...)` but `process_data` is never defined in the snippet, and the node lacks a `name`. Several other snippets share this — readers attempting to run examples verbatim will get NameErrors. Add minimal stub definitions or note these are illustrative.

The warning admonition reads `described in  [\`docs/about/experimental.md\`]` with two spaces before the link. Minor but visible in rendered docs. Also verify the relative link `../about/experimental.md` resolves from `docs/build/nodes.md` in the built site.

issues.description: Lowercase `polars` added to ignore.txt alongside existing `Polars`
issues.detail: `Polars` already exists in the ignore list; adding `polars` separately suggests the Vale style is case-sensitive. If so, fine; if not, this is duplicate. Worth confirming whether a single entry suffices to keep the ignore list minimal.

issues.description: RELEASE.md and tests checklist items left unchecked
issues.detail: The PR checklist shows RELEASE.md not updated and no tests added. For a docs-only PR tests may be unnecessary, but a RELEASE.md entry announcing new documentation for an experimental feature is typically expected. Confirm with maintainers whether this should block merge.

review.summary: This is a documentation-only PR adding a substantial new section to `docs/build/nodes.md` covering the experimental `preview_fn` node feature, plus two small style-config updates. The content is well-structured and covers all preview types with examples. Main concerns are code-example quality: an awkward `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` idiom, an image-preview snippet with a commented-out second return that confuses control flow, and several snippets referencing undefined helper functions that won't run as-is. No correctness or security issues; safe to merge after example polish.
